context_title:
Summarize all the previous points in a single sentence :

Create a complete, production-ready, single-file HTML document implementing a mobile-first documentation link selector application. The document must be fully self-contained, using only the Tailwind CSS CDN and no external frameworks, libraries, or assets beyond the specified CDN. The language of the user interface must be Hungarian. The visual design must be a pure black background with glassmorphism panels, custom checkboxes, and subtle interactive feedback. Every element, style rule, data entry, event handler, and behavioral detail listed below must be implemented exactly and completely with no omissions, placeholders, or simplifications.
Begin by writing the full HTML5 doctype and root element:<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="hu" class="dark">Inside the <head>:
•  Set charset to UTF-8.
•  Set viewport meta to width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0, maximum-scale=1.0, user-scalable=no, viewport-fit=cover.
•  Set document title to “Exa Documentation Selector”.
•  Add Apple mobile web-app capable meta set to “yes”.
•  Add Apple mobile web-app status-bar-style meta set to “black-translucent”.
•  Add theme-color meta set to “#000000”.
•  Load Tailwind CSS from the exact CDN URL 
•  Immediately after the Tailwind script, include an inline configuration script that enables darkMode as ‘class’ and extends the theme with the following custom colors under brand: 50 = ‘#f4f4f5’, 100 = ‘#e4e4e7’, 500 = ‘#71717a’, 900 = ‘#18181b’, 950 = ‘#09090b’, accent = ‘#3b82f6’. Extend fontFamily.sans to the exact array ['-apple-system', 'BlinkMacSystemFont', '"SF Pro Display"', '"SF Pro Text"', 'Inter', 'sans-serif'].
•  Follow with a <style> block containing every rule exactly as specified:
	•  Universal selector * with -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent and user-select: none.
	•  body background-color #000000, color #f4f4f5, and font-feature-settings "cv02", "cv03", "cv04", "cv11".
	•  .glass-panel background rgba(18, 18, 20, 0.75), backdrop-filter and -webkit-backdrop-filter blur(20px), border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.08).
	•  .glass-card background rgba(24, 24, 27, 0.5), border 1px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.05), transition all 0.2s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1).
	•  .glass-card:active transform scale(0.985), background rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.8).
	•  .custom-checkbox width and height 22px, border-radius 7px, border 1.5px solid rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), transition all 0.2s ease, display flex, align-items and justify-content center.
	•  .item-selected .custom-checkbox background-color and border-color both #ffffff.
	•  .item-selected border-color rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.2), background rgba(39, 39, 42, 0.4).
	•  .custom-checkbox svg opacity 0, transform scale(0.5), transition all 0.2s ease.
	•  .item-selected .custom-checkbox svg opacity 1, transform scale(1), color #000000.
	•  Custom scrollbar rules: ::-webkit-scrollbar width 4px; track background #000000; thumb background #27272a, border-radius 2px.
Proceed to the <body> element with exact classes min-h-screen flex flex-col pb-36 antialiased selection:bg-white selection:text-black.
Construct the sticky header as the first child:
•  Classes: sticky top-0 z-40 glass-panel border-b border-white/10 px-4 pt-12 pb-4 sm:pt-6.
•  Inside a max-w-3xl mx-auto flex flex-col gap-4 container:
	•  A flex row with items-center justify-between containing:
		•  Left side: flex items-center gap-3 with a w-3 h-3 rounded-full bg-white animate-pulse indicator followed by an h1 with classes text-xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-white and text content “Exa Docs Hub”.
		•  Right side: a span with id counterBadge, classes text-xs font-mono px-2.5 py-1 rounded-full bg-white/10 text-white/70 border border-white/5, initial text “0 / 0”.
	•  A relative search container holding an input with id searchInput, type text, placeholder “Cím keresése…”, and classes w-full bg-neutral-900/90 text-white placeholder-neutral-500 text-sm rounded-xl px-10 py-3 border border-white/10 focus:outline-none focus:border-white/40 transition-all.
	•  An absolute-positioned search SVG icon (exact path data for magnifying glass) with classes w-4 h-4 absolute left-3.5 top-3.5 text-neutral-500.
	•  A flex row with items-center justify-between text-xs font-medium text-neutral-400 containing:
		•  Two buttons: id selectAllBtn text “Mind kijelölése” and id deselectAllBtn text “Kijelölés törlése”, both with classes px-3 py-1.5 rounded-lg bg-neutral-900 border border-white/10 active:bg-neutral-800 transition.
		•  A span with id visibleCount and class text-neutral-500.
Next construct the main content area:
•  Classes flex-1 max-w-3xl w-full mx-auto px-4 mt-4.
•  Inside it a single empty div with id linksContainer and class space-y-2.
Then construct the fixed bottom bar:
•  Classes fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 z-50 glass-panel border-t border-white/10 p-4 pb-8 sm:pb-4.
•  Inside a max-w-3xl mx-auto flex items-center justify-between gap-4 container:
	•  A flex-col block with a text-xs text-neutral-400 span “Kiválasztva” and an id selectedSummary span with classes text-lg font-bold text-white font-mono initial text “0 elem”.
	•  A button with id copyBtn, classes flex-1 sm:flex-none px-6 py-3.5 rounded-xl bg-white text-black font-semibold text-sm active:scale-95 transition-all duration-200 flex items-center justify-center gap-2 shadow-[0_0_20px_rgba(255,255,255,0.15)], containing an exact copy SVG icon and a span “Linkek másolása”.
Add a toast notification element:
•  id toast, classes fixed top-6 left-1/2 -translate-x-1/2 z-50 glass-panel px-5 py-3 rounded-2xl text-xs font-semibold text-white border border-white/20 shadow-2xl opacity-0 pointer-events-none transition-all duration-300 transform translate-y-[-10px].
Finally place a single <script> block containing the complete application logic. Inside the script:
Define a constant array linkData that holds exactly 160 objects. Each object must contain a title string and a url string with the precise values listed below, in the exact order given (no additions, deletions, or alterations):
Immediately after the array, create a mutable items array by mapping linkData so each element receives an additional numeric id equal to its index and a boolean selected initialized to false.
Cache the following DOM references once: linksContainer, searchInput, counterBadge, selectedSummary, visibleCount, and toast.
Implement the function renderList:
•  Read the current lower-cased, trimmed value of the search input.
•  Clear the container’s innerHTML.
•  Initialize a visible counter to 0.
•  Iterate over every item in items. Skip any item whose title does not contain the query (case-insensitive). For every matching item:
	•  Increment the visible counter.
	•  Create a div with classes glass-card p-4 rounded-xl flex items-center gap-3.5 cursor-pointer plus the conditional class item-selected when the item’s selected flag is true.
	•  Set a data-id attribute to the item’s id.
	•  Populate the div’s innerHTML with a custom-checkbox div containing the exact checkmark SVG path, followed by a span with classes text-sm font-medium text-neutral-200 leading-snug break-words whose text content is the HTML-escaped title.
	•  Attach a click listener that calls toggleSelection with the item’s id.
	•  Append the card to the container.
•  Update the visibleCount text to “${visible} találat” when a query is active, otherwise empty.
•  Call updateStats.
Implement toggleSelection(id):
•  Invert the selected flag of the corresponding item.
•  Locate the card by data-id and add or remove the item-selected class accordingly.
•  Call updateStats and triggerHaptic.
Implement updateStats:
•  Count the number of items whose selected flag is true.
•  Set counterBadge text to “${selectedCount} / ${items.length}”.
•  Set selectedSummary text to “${selectedCount} elem”.
•  If the WebKit message handler selectionChanged exists, post a message containing the selected count.
Implement escapeHtml(text) by creating a temporary div, assigning the text to its textContent, and returning its innerHTML.
Implement triggerHaptic that calls navigator.vibrate(10) when available.
Implement showToast(message) that sets the toast text, removes the opacity-0 / pointer-events-none / translate-y-[-10px] classes, adds opacity-100 and translate-y-0, then after 2500 ms restores the hidden state classes.
Attach a click listener to selectAllBtn that sets selected = true on every item that either has an empty query or matches the current query, then calls renderList and triggerHaptic.
Attach a click listener to deselectAllBtn that sets selected = false on every item, then calls renderList and triggerHaptic.
Attach an input listener to searchInput that calls renderList.
Attach a click listener to copyBtn that:
•  Collects the urls of all selected items.
•  If the collection is empty, shows the toast “Nincs kijelölve egyetlen elem sem!” and returns.
•  Joins the urls with newline characters.
•  Creates a temporary textarea, inserts the joined text, selects it, and attempts document.execCommand('copy').
•  Falls back to navigator.clipboard.writeText when available.
•  If the WebKit message handler copyToClipboard exists, posts the joined text.
•  Calls triggerHaptic and shows the toast “${selectedUrls.length} link másolva a vágólapra!”.
Conclude the script by invoking renderList() once to populate the initial view.
The finished HTML file must be syntactically valid, contain every listed style rule, every listed data entry, every listed event handler, every listed Hungarian string, and every listed visual and behavioral detail with zero truncation, abstraction, or substitution. Output only the complete HTML source.I want to upgrade the existing single-file documentation link selector application so that its complete visual design, surface rendering, interaction model, and component system are replaced by the full production GlassKit v1.0.0 library (the exact single-file JavaScript source provided) while preserving every functional behavior, data set, Hungarian UI string, selection logic, search filtering, clipboard copy path, haptic feedback, WebKit bridge, counter, toast, and list item exactly as previously specified, resulting in a fully working, production-ready single HTML file that mounts GlassKit, registers all its custom elements, applies genuine glass surfaces with correct blur/refraction/specular/edge treatment, and renders the entire interface exclusively through GlassKit primitives and effects with zero residual Tailwind, CSS-glass, or placeholder styling.
Construct the upgraded document as follows.
Begin with a complete HTML5 skeleton whose <head> contains only the charset, viewport, title, Apple mobile-web-app and theme-color meta tags, and a single inline <script> that embeds the entire unabridged GlassKit factory (the full source beginning with the UMD wrapper and ending with the custom-element registration and return GlassKit). Immediately after that script, insert a second inline script that performs GlassKit.mount(document.body, { maxDPR: 2, debug: false, glassAppearance: 'regular' }) once the DOM is ready.
Replace the previous Tailwind-driven layout with the following GlassKit-native structure, using only the custom elements and APIs defined inside the provided GlassKit source:
•  A root gk-window-frame that fills the viewport and hosts a gk-glass-container configured with regular variant, default spacing 40, blur radius 28, edge thickness 0.22, refraction 1.0, IOR 1.45, and chromatic aberration matching the regular preset.
•  Inside the container place a sticky top gk-toolbar that contains:
	•  a leading gk-toolbar-item holding a pulsing indicator and the exact title string “Exa Docs Hub”,
	•  a trailing gk-badge bound to the selection counter (format “N / total”),
	•  a full-width gk-search-field whose placeholder is the exact Hungarian string “Cím keresése…”,
	•  two gk-button instances labelled “Mind kijelölése” and “Kijelölés törlése” that invoke the same select-all / deselect-all logic previously defined.
•  The main scrollable region must be a gk-scroll-view whose content is a gk-list of gk-list-row elements. Each row is generated from the identical 160-entry linkData array (titles and URLs unchanged). Every row exposes:
	•  a custom leading checkbox surface realized as a small circular or rounded-rect gk-glass-container whose selected state is driven by the row’s selected flag and which renders the checkmark via a gk-icon,
	•  the exact title text,
	•  press-scale interaction (0.96–0.98) and haptic vibration on toggle,
	•  the same click-to-toggle, search-filter visibility, and WebKit selectionChanged postMessage behavior.
•  The fixed bottom action bar is realized as a second gk-glass-container (or gk-toolbar) that shows the Hungarian “Kiválasztva” label, a live gk-badge displaying “N elem”, and a primary gk-button labelled “Linkek másolása” that performs the identical multi-URL newline-joined clipboard write (including the temporary textarea fallback, navigator.clipboard, and WebKit copyToClipboard bridge) and then displays a transient toast via a GlassKit alert or popover whose text matches the original success / empty-selection messages.
All visual styling previously supplied by Tailwind classes or the custom .glass-panel / .glass-card / .custom-checkbox rules must be removed. Surface appearance, blur, refraction, specular highlights, edge lighting, press dent, contrast-lift, and quality-tier adaptation are obtained exclusively by calling the GlassKit Glass, Shape, and Renderer APIs that are already present in the embedded library. Background extensions, safe-area insets, and scroll-edge effects defined by GlassKit must be applied where the layout meets the viewport edges.
The JavaScript logic that builds the items array, implements renderList, toggleSelection, updateStats, escapeHtml, triggerHaptic, showToast, and the four event listeners remains functionally identical; only the DOM construction and class/style manipulation are rewritten to create, update, and destroy the corresponding GlassKit custom elements and to keep their properties (selected, title, disabled, etc.) in sync with the data model.
The finished file must contain:
1.  the complete, unmodified GlassKit source inside the first script tag,
2.  the original 160-entry linkData array with every title and URL preserved,
3.  every Hungarian string exactly as specified,
4.  every behavioral side-effect (selection count, clipboard, haptic, WebKit bridges, toast timing),
5.  zero external network requests beyond the initial page load,
6.  zero residual Tailwind or hand-written glass CSS.
Success is defined as a single HTML document that, when opened in a modern browser, mounts GlassKit, renders a fully interactive glass documentation selector whose surfaces exhibit the authentic GlassKit refraction, blur, specular, and edge treatment, and whose selection, search, and copy operations behave identically to the prior implementation while using only GlassKit primitives.
Send back the complete code with all the fixes. Fix each of the listed errors one by one, making sure to actually correct them so that there are 0 errors remaining. Keep the original imports, since the files exist. Write out every single character; do not abbreviate anything. Fix every error. There must be exactly one file. Do not write anything else; just output the complete code, and it must not contain any comments. Never, under any circumstances, use simplified, substitute, dummy, simulated, or fake code. Write the entire file as complete, unabridged, production-ready code in a single code block. It must be 100% error-free, a complete, error-free file, and must be submitted as a downloadable file. These requirements are mandatory and must be strictly adhered to. If no list of errors is provided, you must find all the errors and fix them. If there were comments in the original code, delete them. And most importantly: YOU MUST NEVER SIMPLIFY!
